status: proposed verification obligations; entries do not prove these drills passed

scenarios.name: fresh-or-replaced-database
assertions: No Claim, core, helper, Git, allocation, acquisition or setup call, even with an old successful cancel ACK.

scenarios.name: same-peer-exact-history
assertions: Kernel peer UID and exact original typed digest select the receipt.
Return original status and UTF8 bytes exactly; do not reserialize or renew its grant.

scenarios.name: cross-peer-and-digest
assertions: Another UID cannot read the prior owner receipt.
Changed digest for the same UID and ID conflicts without effects.

scenarios.name: normal-slots-full
assertions: Bounded read admission works independently of all64 normal slots and growth receipt capacity.
Read saturation cannot consume reserved cancellation admission or grow unbounded workers.

Exactly two active read slots; excess returns503 immediately, total64normal+2read+8classification ceiling74. Close/promotion accounting preserves cancellation reservations until underlying Close completes.

scenarios.name: restart-and-unknown
assertions: Restart never dispatches through receipt reads.
Unknown/interrupted/cancelled/absent evidence remains parked; no source-body resend or owner inference.

scenarios.name: historical-token-only
assertions: Client reparses against exact privately saved original source request.
Historical grant may support only separately authorized exact original token cleanup, never new execution, acquisition, readiness or ownership.

scenarios.name: operator-demoted-to-readers
assertions: Current configured Operators[kernelpeerUID] is required before any receipt lookup.
Readers-only, demoted and unauthorized peers receive forbidden without receipt existence disclosure, even if they held the original operation.
